title: G.A.T.E (gifted program) curiosity
content: So I've seen a handful of gifted program posts in connection to visiting the mall world. I went down the rabbit hole but one thing that I want to know is how many of us had parents who were in the military? I was in G.A.T.E (LEAP) in the late 90s and both my parents served. I think most of the kids in my group had military parents as well.
